# Validating Study Data with openstudyval

This vignette shows how to use the enhanced openstudyval package.

## Basic Validation

```{r}
library(openstudyval)

report <- validate_submission(example_study("sdtm"), standard = "SDTM")
summary(report)
```

## Using a YAML Configuration

Create a file `config.yaml`:

```yaml
standard: SDTM
standard_version: "3.3"
severity: ["Reject", "Error"]
```

Then run:

```{r eval=FALSE}
report <- validate_from_config("path/to/your/study", "config.yaml")
```

## Exporting Reports

```{r eval=FALSE}
write_validation_report(report, "validation.html")
write_validation_report(report, "validation.xlsx", format = "excel")
```

## Important Note

openstudyval is an independent open-source tool for early checks.  
It is **not** a replacement for Pinnacle 21 Enterprise or other commercial validators used for formal regulatory submissions.
